_comment: What a model is told about an action when a Task is drafted from a description (mapcards, mapdraft).
'name' must be the action's name in actionc: a test fails if one drifts.
'does' is one plain sentence on what the action is for; 'phrases' are the words a person might use
for it (they decide which actions a description is matched with); 'note' is a pitfall worth a line.
The arguments are never written here: they are read off the editor, so they cannot drift.

15t.name: Lock
15t.does: Show Tasker's own lock screen that needs a code to dismiss.

20t.name: Launch App
20t.note: The app itself is chosen in the editor and is not set by a draft.

22t.name: Load Last App
22t.does: Go back to the app that was open before.

30t.name: Wait
30t.does: Pause the Task for a length of time.
30t.note: Set only the unit asked for: Seconds for seconds, Minutes for minutes. MS is milliseconds.

35t.name: Wait Until
35t.does: Pause until a time of day, rather than for a length of time.
35t.note: To wait for a length of time use Wait.

41t.name: Send SMS
41t.does: Send a text message to a phone number.

46t.name: Create Scene
46t.does: Build a custom screen (Scene) in memory, to show later.

47t.name: Show Scene
47t.does: Show a Scene on the screen.

48t.name: Hide Scene
48t.does: Hide a Scene without removing it.

59t.name: Reboot
59t.does: Restart or shut down the phone (needs root).

61t.name: Vibrate
61t.does: Vibrate the phone for a time in milliseconds.
61t.note: Time is in milliseconds: 1000 is one second.

62t.name: Vibrate Pattern
62t.does: Vibrate in a pattern of buzzes and pauses.

90t.name: Call
90t.note: Tick Auto Dial to call at once; otherwise it only opens the dialler.

95t.name: Call Block
95t.does: Block calls from a number or all calls.

101t.name: Take Photo
101t.does: Take a picture with the camera and save it to a file.

102t.name: Open File
102t.does: Open a file in the app that handles its type.

104t.name: Browse URL
104t.does: Open a web address in the browser.
104t.note: Write the address in full, starting http:// or https://.

109t.name: Set Wallpaper
109t.does: Change the wallpaper to an image.

111t.name: Compose MMS
111t.does: Open the messaging app with a picture message already written.

113t.name: WiFi Tether (Hotspot)
113t.does: Turn the phone's Wi-Fi hotspot on or off.
113t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

114t.name: USB Tether
114t.does: Turn USB tethering on or off.
114t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

116t.name: HTTP Post
116t.does: Send data to a web address with a POST.

117t.name: HTTP Head
117t.does: Fetch only the headers of a web address.

118t.name: HTTP Get
118t.does: Fetch a web address with a simple GET.
118t.note: HTTP Request is the more flexible choice for an API.

119t.name: Open Map
119t.does: Open the map app at a place or address.

123t.name: Run Shell
123t.does: Run a shell command and keep its output.

125t.name: Compose Email
125t.does: Open the email app with a message already written.

126t.name: Return
126t.does: End the Task and hand a value back to the Task that performed it.

129t.name: JavaScriptlet
129t.does: Run a few lines of JavaScript right in the Task.

130t.name: Perform Task
130t.does: Run another Task by name, optionally passing it values and taking one back.
130t.note: Values passed arrive in the other Task as %par1 and %par2. Only name a Task the description names.

135t.name: Goto
135t.does: Jump to another action in the same Task, by action number.

137t.name: Stop
137t.does: End the Task here, without running the rest of it.

142t.name: Edit Task
142t.does: Change the actions of a Task while Tasker runs.

150t.name: Keyguard
150t.does: Turn the lock screen on or off.

159t.name: Profile Status
159t.does: Turn a named Profile on or off.

175t.name: Power Mode
175t.does: Switch battery saver on, off or toggle it.

176t.name: Take Screenshot
176t.does: Save a picture of the screen to a file.

177t.name: Haptic Feedback
177t.does: Give a short tap of haptic feedback.

192t.name: Play Ringtone
192t.does: Play a ringtone or alarm sound.

206t.name: WIFI Settings
206t.does: Open Android's Wi-Fi settings screen; it does not change Wi-Fi itself.

218t.name: Bluetooth Settings
218t.does: Open Android's Bluetooth settings screen; it does not change Bluetooth itself.

249t.name: System Screenshot
249t.does: Take a screenshot the way the system does.

250t.name: Compose SMS
250t.does: Open the messaging app with a text already written, to be sent by hand.

254t.name: Speakerphone
254t.does: Turn the speakerphone on or off.

294t.name: Bluetooth
294t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

304t.name: Ringer Volume
304t.does: Set the volume of the ringer.

306t.name: In-Call Volume
306t.does: Set the volume during phone calls.

307t.name: Media Volume
307t.does: Set the volume of music, video and games.

308t.name: System Volume
308t.does: Set the volume of system sounds.

310t.name: Silent Mode
310t.does: Switch silent mode off or to vibrate.

312t.name: Interrupt Mode
312t.does: Set Do Not Disturb: none, priority only, alarms only, or allow all.

313t.name: Sound Mode
313t.does: Set the phone to normal, vibrate or silent.

314t.name: Authentication Dialog
314t.does: Ask the user to confirm with fingerprint, face or PIN.

317t.name: NFC
317t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

318t.name: Force Rotation
318t.does: Force the screen into portrait or landscape.

320t.name: Ping
320t.does: Test whether a host answers over the network.

332t.name: GPS
332t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

333t.name: Airplane Mode
333t.does: Turn airplane (flight) mode on or off.
333t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

339t.name: HTTP Request
339t.does: Call a web address (GET, POST and so on) and keep the reply.
339t.note: The reply body is in %http_data and the status in %http_response_code. Put one header per line as Name:value.

340t.name: Bluetooth Connection
340t.does: Connect to or disconnect from a paired Bluetooth device.

342t.name: Test File
342t.does: Test whether a file exists, its size or its type, and keep the answer in a variable.

351t.name: HTTP Auth
351t.does: Set a username and password for web requests.

354t.name: Array Set
354t.does: Create an array variable from a list of values.

355t.name: Array Push
355t.does: Add a value to an array variable.

356t.name: Array Pop
356t.does: Remove a value from an array variable.

358t.name: Bluetooth Info
358t.does: Read information about a Bluetooth device.

360t.name: Input Dialog
360t.does: Ask the user to type something, and keep the answer in a variable.

361t.name: Dark Mode
361t.does: Turn the system dark theme on or off.
361t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

364t.name: Test Next Alarm
364t.does: Find out when the next alarm will go off.

365t.name: Tasker Function
365t.does: Call one of Tasker's built-in functions, such as a math or text function.

366t.name: Get Location v2
366t.does: Find the phone's position with the newer location service; the result is in %gl_latitude and %gl_longitude.

369t.name: Array Process
369t.does: Sort, reverse, shuffle or remove duplicates from an array variable.

372t.name: Sensor Info
372t.does: Read a phone sensor such as light, proximity or the compass.

376t.name: Share File
376t.does: Offer a file to the Android share sheet.

377t.name: Text/Image Dialog
377t.does: Show a dialog with text or an image.

378t.name: List Dialog
378t.does: Show a list for the user to choose from.

384t.name: Device Control (Power Menu Action)
384t.does: Open the power menu or run a power-menu action.

389t.name: Multiple Variables Set
389t.does: Set several variables at once from lists of names and values.

390t.name: Pick Input Dialog
390t.does: Ask the user to pick a date, time, colour or similar value.

393t.name: Arrays Merge
393t.does: Combine two array variables into one.

394t.name: Parse/Format DateTime
394t.does: Get the date or time in a chosen format, convert between formats, or add days, hours and so on.
394t.note: Leave Input Type as Now for the current date and time; Output Format uses letters such as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm.

396t.name: Simple Match/Regex
396t.does: Test text against a pattern or regular expression and keep the matches.

398t.name: Connect To WiFi
398t.does: Connect to a named Wi-Fi network.

400t.name: Move
400t.does: Move or rename a file or folder.

404t.name: Copy File
404t.does: Copy a file to another place.

405t.name: Copy Dir
405t.does: Copy a folder and what is in it.

410t.name: Write File
410t.does: Write text to a file, replacing it or adding to it.

412t.name: List Files
412t.does: List the files in a folder into an array variable.

415t.name: Read Line
415t.does: Read one line of a text file.

417t.name: Read File
417t.does: Read a text file into a variable.

418t.name: Get Calendar Events
418t.does: Read the events in the calendar into variables.

420t.name: Zip
420t.does: Compress files into a zip archive.

424t.name: Get Battery Info
424t.does: Read battery details such as level, temperature and health into variables.

425t.name: WiFi
425t.note: Tick Set to turn it on; leave it off to turn it off.

432t.name: Get Network Info
432t.does: Read details of the current network: Wi-Fi name, signal, IP address.

433t.name: Mobile Data
433t.does: Turn mobile data on or off.
433t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

443t.name: Media Control
443t.does: Play, pause, skip or stop whatever media app is playing.

446t.name: Get Files/Folders Properties
446t.does: Read the size, date and other properties of files.

447t.name: Music Play Dir
447t.does: Play the music in a folder.

448t.name: Array Compare
448t.does: Compare two arrays and find what they share or lack.

449t.name: Music Stop
449t.does: Stop the music Tasker is playing.

451t.name: Music Skip
451t.does: Skip forward or back in the music Tasker is playing.

455t.name: Record Audio
455t.does: Record sound from the microphone to a file.

473t.name: Get Sunrise/Sunset Times
473t.does: Find today's sunrise and sunset for a location.

479t.name: Show Scene v2
479t.does: Show a version 2 Scene on the screen.

511t.name: Torch
511t.does: Turn the camera flashlight on or off.
511t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

512t.name: Status Bar
512t.does: Expand or collapse the notification panel.

513t.name: Close System Dialogs
513t.does: Close any open system dialog or the notification panel.

523t.name: Notify

523t.note: Give a Title or Text; both may use variables.

543t.name: Start System Timer
543t.does: Start the Android clock's countdown timer.

545t.does: Set a variable to a random whole number between a minimum and a maximum.

547t.name: Variable Set
547t.does: Store a value in a variable.

548t.does: Show a short pop-up message (a toast) on the screen.
548t.note: Tick Long to keep it on screen longer.

550t.name: Popup
550t.does: Show a pop-up box with a title and text over the screen.

566t.name: Set Alarm
566t.does: Set an alarm in the clock app.

567t.name: Calendar Insert
567t.does: Add an event to the calendar.

590t.name: Variable Split
590t.does: Split a variable's text into parts at a separator, as %name1, %name2 and so on.

592t.name: Variable Join
592t.does: Join the parts of an array variable into one text.

596t.name: Variable Convert
596t.does: Convert a variable: bytes to megabytes, a date to seconds, upper or lower case, Base64, URL encoding, hashes.

597t.name: Variable Section
597t.does: Take part of a variable's text: from a position, for a length.

598t.name: Variable Search Replace
598t.does: Search the text in a variable, optionally with a regular expression, and replace what matches.

667t.name: SQL Query
667t.does: Run a SQL query on a database file.

697t.name: Shut Up
697t.does: Stop any speech that is in progress.

699t.name: Say To File
699t.does: Turn text into spoken audio and save it as a file.

779t.name: Notify Cancel
779t.does: Remove a notification that Notify posted.

808t.name: Auto Brightness
808t.does: Turn automatic screen brightness on or off.
808t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.

812t.name: Display Timeout
812t.does: Set how long the screen stays on before it turns off.

815t.name: List Apps
815t.does: List the installed apps into an array variable.

820t.name: Stay On
820t.does: Keep the screen on while the phone is plugged in.

822t.name: Display AutoRotate
822t.does: Turn automatic screen rotation on or off.

877t.name: Send Intent
877t.does: Send an Android intent to start an app screen or send a broadcast to another app.

888t.name: Variable Add
888t.does: Add a number to a variable.

890t.name: Variable Subtract
890t.does: Subtract a number from a variable.

902t.name: Get Location
902t.does: Find where the phone is, using GPS or the network, into location variables such as %LOC.

905t.name: Location Mode
905t.does: Set Android's location mode (off, device only, battery saving, high accuracy).

988t.name: Car Mode
988t.does: Turn car mode on or off.
988t.note: Tick Set to turn it on.
